_comment: Logical art names -> files, relative to assets/. The pixel build (a future PixelRenderer, see CLAUDE.md) resolves names through here so draw code never hardcodes paths. The terminal/curses front-end ignores this entirely. Masters for everything live in iCloud (GAMES/SUCK UP); the repo carries the curated, game-used frames only.

title.use: boot / attract title card, logo baked in — the flat reference composite. Dave on the night farm, two saucers (P1 green + P2 cyan), the green abduction beam, the SUCK UP marquee.

title_clean.use: the title scene WITHOUT the logo — the background plate. Layer the logo over this so the pixel build can animate the marquee (drip / beam pulse) independently of the scene.

logo.use: the SUCK UP marquee — image-traced, BEAM-LESS, trimmed to content. The title projects an animated green beam SPRITE from its belly (so the beam breathes/extends on its own); composite over title_clean or any background.
logo.source: iCloud: GAMES/SUCK UP/TITLE/TITLE EXPORTS/TITLE UPDATED IMAGE TRACE.png

ck_logo.use: Castle Killscreen label mark (neon castle/ziggurat). The attract reel opens on a CK ident: this logo on near-black with a Stranger-Things red-neon bloom + the MYSTERY transition cue.
ck_logo.source: iCloud: Anders & Partners .../CASTLE KILL SCREEN PR/CASTLE KILLSCREEN LOGO.png

ck_tower.use: CK castle tower (purple neon) for the load-up gag

cabs._comment: The 'special cab' art for the boot cinematic (CAB_SKINS in suck_up_art.py). Every Castle Killscreen game gets the same boot: a 5s Ken Burns slow push on the full cab — the CK logo lit on its blank monitor — then a cut to the attract. `screen` is the monitor window (l,t,r,b) as fractions of the square art, measured off the PNG (the live feed / CK ident composites into it). FINAL = the arcade cab (cheats/coin-op features live here); ALT = the in-arcade beauty/feed shot, screen jailbroken (punched out).

final.use: the default arcade cab: head-on, green P1 + blue P2 decks, MILITARY RESPONSE meter, TARGET PAYOFF file cards.

alt.use: the ALT 'feed' cab: the cabinet in a blacklight arcade (PRIZES neon, alien neon, 'THEY ARE NOT RANDOM'). Screen jailbroken so the CK ident / a live feed shows through. Select with --cab alt.
alt.source: iCloud: GAMES/SUCK UP/CAB/0609 ALT CAB FINAL.png

interviews._comment: Talking-head frames the attract pods cycle (THE SUCK UP FILES). The _attract_head pod flips frames every ~12 ticks; 4 frames reads as a lively cut.

drl.use: Dr. L. (HOST) interview pod — cycles under the 12 HOST_QUOTES.
drl.source: iCloud: GAMES/SUCK UP/POD 1 (20 masters; these 4 curated)

dave.use: Dave interview pod — cycles under the 8 DAVE_QUOTES. Backyard at dusk (smoker + brisket + string lights), consistent setting so the frames cut together.

drwolfe.use: Dr. H. Wolfe — the occult Roman historian / gnome-army expert. The on-camera authority for THE GNOMEAN FILES (jailbroken-only tail pod). 7 talking-head frames.

broll._comment: Documentary cutaway inserts — texture beats the attract reel cuts to over narration / the Dave spotlight.

dave_family_photo.use: emotional beat — Dave at dusk looking at a framed family photo. Pairs with the DAVE_MONOLOGUE family lines ('His castle. His wife. His boys. Scraps the dog.').

family_portrait.use: the family, given faces — Dave, wife Brenda, the two boys, and Ol' Scraps the golden retriever at the red barn (sunset). Lore card / Scraps reference (Scraps appears in DAVE'S BACKYARD).

ancient_sighting.use: cold-open HOOK plate — vintage UFO over the Sphinx/pyramids ('for decades we counted sightings'). The conspiracy stretches back centuries.

cosmic_ledger.use: the 'keeping score' cosmic beat — floating clocks + ancient ledgers over a galaxy. Backs the hook turn and Dr. L's 'how does it KNOW' / 'keeping count'.

cosmic_hive.use: magnetar / neutron star firing twin jets — Dr. L's 'two saucers, one meter... that is a HIVE.'

top_secret.use: redacted DoD TOP SECRET file with a recovered entity photo — Dr. L conspiracy beat ('ask who PROFITS', 'they take what is NAMED').

the_accord.use: vintage 'first handshake' — government men greeting greys on a military field. Dr. L conspiracy texture.

taught_flight.use: a grey at the drafting table with period aviators + flight-principles chalkboard — 'did a HUMAN write this?'.

taught_fire.use: CONSPIRACY MONTAGE — a grey lighting the first fire for cavemen in a painted cave. 'FIRE.'

taught_wings.use: CONSPIRACY MONTAGE — a grey showing period aviators a laptop by a biplane. 'FLIGHT.'

taught_math.use: CONSPIRACY MONTAGE — a grey at a chalkboard of relativity with Einstein. 'THE MATH.'

taught_build.use: CONSPIRACY MONTAGE — a grey showing monks a rocket blueprint by candlelight. 'THE MACHINE.'

tonight_on.use: channel-guide BUMPER (self-contained designed card, shown full-bleed via the 'plate' kind) — TONIGHT ON TRUTHJUNKET TV, with THE SUCK UP FILES 'ON NOW'. Frames the whole reel as a late-night conspiracy broadcast.

tj_bug.use: the TJTV channel 'bug' (transparent logo watermark) drawn top-right over the reel footage + cards, like a live broadcast. Replaces the old top-right show-name text.

tj_glitch.use: horizontal signal-tear glitch band (transparent) — the DIGITAL TRANSITION into each TJTV bumper: scans down and fades, clearing to the channel ident.

pax_gnomania.use: TJTV promo (attract plate): PAX GNOMANIA — the secret gnome army documentary, ties the gnome lore into the conspiracy. Dr. H. Wolfe. Square 1024 export (fills the attract plate cleanly).

hadrian_legion.use: TJTV promo (attract plate): HADRIANS SECRET GNOMEAN LEGION — SPQG, the Roman gnome legion. Square 1024 export (fills the attract plate cleanly).

two_saucers.use: the reusable 'always two' b-roll plate (green = P1, blue = P2 over a Maryland field, barn+silo on the horizon) — backs the cold-open HOOK, the narration outro, and transitions. SQUARE 4417x4417 so it covers the square window edge-to-edge with both orbs in frame (the old 16:9 version cropped one orb out).

beltway_traffic.use: THE BELTWAY (I-695) establishing shot — bumper-to-bumper night traffic under the BELTWAY EXIT ONLY sign. Backs the investigation cutaway; the source plate for the planned Beltway stage backdrop.
beltway_traffic.source: iCloud: GAMES/SUCK UP/SPRITES/SPRITE CUT UP/BELTWAY FRAME SPRITE.png (cropped to content)

claw_and_order.use: CLAW & ORDER bonus-stage establishing still — the Maryland crab feast (steamed Old Bay crabs, mallets, Browies, the giant #1 jimmy = THE BULL). Mirrors the DAVE'S BACKYARD smoker shot.

sprites._comment: In-game gameplay sprites (transparent cut-outs, trimmed) for the future PixelRenderer. Curated + recolored from the SPRITES master folder by tools/ingest_sprites.py — re-run it to re-pick when new renders land. Saucers are beam-OFF idles (the beam is its own sprite, composited under the saucer when beaming). The SUPER BEAM / impact are generated white and tinted per player.
sprites._warble_comment: WARBLE/bonk spin frames (yaw turntable, 6 frames) sliced from the traced strips; played by index off the engine's WARBLE_SPIN cycle.

audio._comment: Logical audio name -> path (relative to assets/), resolved by the Audio manager in suck_up_art.py. A list = a random-variant pool. 'music' = looping beds (crossfaded); 'sfx' = one-shots. The terminal game ignores this entirely (zero-dependency, no audio). Masters live in iCloud / Desktop FED; the repo carries the game-used mp3s.
